landing.faq1A: We are onboarding companies from the waitlist in small groups. Join, and we'll email you when your access is ready. Your two-week free trial starts then.
landing.faq2Q: Does Lichit submit offers for me?
landing.faq2A: No. Lichit finds, checks and drafts. You review everything and submit on SEAP yourself.
landing.faq3Q: How does it know which tenders I can win?
landing.faq3A: It compares every requirement with your company file and looks at the buyer's past awards: who won, and with what offer.
landing.faq4Q: Where does the data come from?
landing.faq4A: From SEAP (e-licitatie.ro), the official Romanian public procurement platform, including the award notices of past tenders.
landing.faq5A: Plans start at 199 RON a month plus VAT. Everyone on the waitlist gets the first two weeks free on any plan.

landing.m_discIntro: SEAP publishes hundreds of notices a day, most with long legal titles. Lichit reads them for you, keeps the ones that match your company and rewrites each title so you know in one line what is being bought.
landing.m_discS1Body: New notices are fetched from e-licitatie.ro several times a day, with the documents attached to them.
landing.m_discS2Body: Your CPV codes, counties, value range and procedure types decide what reaches your feed. Words you exclude never show up.
landing.m_discS3Body: AI shortens each official title and summarises what the authority wants, so you can decide in seconds.
landing.m_eligIntro: Eligibility is where most bids fail. Lichit extracts each requirement from the fișa de date, even from scanned PDFs, and compares it with your company file using exact numbers instead of guesses.
landing.m_eligS1Body: Turnover, similar works, certificates and guarantees are read from the tender documents. Scanned pages are read with OCR.
landing.m_eligS2Body: Each threshold is checked against the figures in your company profile, one requirement at a time.
landing.m_eligS3Body: Met, not met, or couldn't verify. When the file is unclear, Lichit says so instead of guessing.
landing.mEligLine: Cifra de afaceri medie anuală pe ultimii 3 ani: minimum 6.000.000 lei
landing.mEligReqLine: Average turnover, last 3 years: at least RON 6,000,000
landing.m_genIntro: Writing an offer from a blank page takes days. Lichit's five agents each own one part of the work and sign what they write, so you can see where every section came from and change it.
landing.m_genS1Body: Certificates, past contracts and company data you uploaded become the evidence in the draft.
landing.m_genS2Body: The spec analyst, eligibility checker, legal reviewer, writer and risk assessor each label their sections.
landing.m_genS3Body: Edit any section, ask AI to revise a passage, then export to PDF. Nothing is submitted for you.
landing.pGenSpecRole: Reads the tender file and lists every requirement
landing.pGenEligRole: Maps each requirement to your company
landing.pGenWriterRole: Writes the offer narrative and evidence annex
landing.pGenRiskRole: Flags gaps, missing documents and price exposure
landing.m_mktIntro: Knowing the incumbent changes how you bid. Lichit reads past award notices to show which firms a buyer has chosen in your CPV group, and spots contracts that are tendered on a regular cycle.
landing.m_mktS1Body: Award notices show who won, for how much and how often, in each CPV group.
landing.m_mktS2Body: See whether one firm keeps winning or whether the field is open.
landing.m_mktS3Body: Recurring contracts are spotted from their history, so you can prepare before the notice is published.
landing.mMktNote: This contract was awarded every two years, each time in spring. The next tender is likely around March 2027.

about.title: Public tenders favor insiders. We're fixing that.
about.intro: Lichit is an AI copilot that helps small and mid-size companies find Romanian public tenders they can actually win, and draft the bid with them, from first notice to submission.
about.problemBody: Thousands of SEAP notices go out every week, written in dense procurement language. Big firms have bid teams; most SMEs have an owner doing paperwork at midnight. The result isn't that small firms lose tenders. It's that they never apply at all.
about.what1: Watches the SEAP feed and surfaces tenders matched to your profile.
about.what2: Scores every match with explicit, checkable reasons.
about.what3: Drafts the technical offer, financials and DUAE with a panel of five specialist AI agents.
about.what4: Tracks every bid through a kanban pipeline to submission day.
about.honestBody: Lichit is a hackathon project, built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon. It is a working prototype in early access: real product, real code, but early days. If you bid on Romanian public tenders and want to try it, join the waitlist.
